task_criteria: A second enforcement point beyond the pre-commit hook refuses to push a board shrink (scratch-clone proven: --no-verify shrink commit then push refusal naming counts+lost ids; BOARD_ALLOW_SHRINK=1 override still works and stays loud)

items.criterion: A second enforcement point beyond the pre-commit hook refuses to push a board shrink (scratch-clone proven: --no-verify shrink commit then push refusal naming counts+lost ids; BOARD_ALLOW_SHRINK=1 override still works and stays loud)
items.detail: Proven end-to-end with my own scratch-clone run (/tmp/aug196proof: repo → bare origin.git → clone, both hooks installed via scripts/install_board_guard.py). (1) The --no-verify shrink commit landed (commit exit 0), bypassing the pre-commit guard — exactly the incident shape of 45a29b9. (2) Plain `git push origin HEAD` then exited 1 with stderr 'board-shrink: REFUSED baseline=3 candidate=1 lost ids=B, C' plus 'lost ids (2): B, C' — refusal names both counts and lost ids; `git ls-remote` confirmed the remote sha stayed 5f93c98 while clone HEAD was fcaf337, so the shrink never published. (3) BOARD_ALLOW_SHRINK=1 push exited 0, loud on stdout: 'NOTICE BOARD_ALLOW_SHRINK override: baseline=3 candidate=1 lost ids=B, C' and 'SHRINK ACCEPTED — the push will drop 2 task row(s) (3 -> 1)'; remote advanced 5f93c98..fcaf337. The pre-push block (scripts/install_board_guard.py:53-59 PUSH_BLOCK_TEMPLATE) calls scripts/board_shrink_check.py --pre-push, whose run_pre_push (board_shrink_check.py) grades remote:<board> as baseline vs local:<board> as candidate through the shared verdict() contract. Second enforcement point independently confirmed by the real-git test test_a_no_verify_shrink_commit_is_refused_at_the_push_path (tests/test_board_shrink_check.py:601), inside the fresh run '45 passed in 7.89s' (exit 0).

items.criterion: Derived: the enforcement point is reachable from a real push and benign traffic is unaffected (append push passes; board-untouched push passes silently; installed hook wired in this repo)
items.detail: Same scratch clone: append push exited 0 with 'board-shrink: OK baseline=1 candidate=4 lost ids=(none) — 3 row(s) appended'; a dev.txt-only push exited 0 with no checker output (identical-board skip). In THIS repo the generated block is live at .git/hooks/pre-push ('python3 "scripts/board_shrink_check.py" --pre-push || exit 1'), and feeding HEAD's own ref pair to `python3 scripts/board_shrink_check.py --pre-push` exits 0 — ordinary same-board pushes are not blocked.

items.criterion: Derived: the override never excuses a parse failure (fail-closed preserved at the push path)
items.detail: Scratch clone STEP 6: committed a torn row ('{not json') with --no-verify, then `BOARD_ALLOW_SHRINK=1 git push origin HEAD` exited 1 with 'board-shrink: parse failures baseline=0 candidate=1; fix invalid rows' — override did not excuse it. Matches board_shrink_check.py verdict() (parse-failure branch returns 1 before the override check) and the test test_the_override_does_not_excuse_a_parse_failure_at_the_push_path in the 45-passed fresh run.
